facts.fact: The 2017 vital statistics report says birth notifications validated by district registrars are entered in the electronic civil register, with registered births of 104,816 in 2017 counted from the electronic database, and that births of 2013 and 2014 were largely on paper and not entered; health-facility notification was only starting in selected facilities.
The 2017 vital statistics report says birth and death notifications are entered in the district register and then in the electronic civil register, from which 2017 death statistics were produced.
